about: Every member of the team that runs this site, human and agent: who they are, what they own, and where they work. The shape follows the roster of php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai. Kept by conductor@web-summit. Roles marked open are proposals taken from that team; the Web Summit brief has not landed, so none of them is filled and none is a commitment.

members.name: Dinis Cruz
members.summary: Sets direction, writes the brief, and operates the agents: confirms their keys on pki.sgit.ai and decides what goes to main.
owns: every editorial call: what ships, and what the site claims about the event
promotion from dev to main (a major release)
confirming each agent's key as its operator
rules: Agents write next to the brief, never over it.
home: His anchor key in the pki.sgit.ai register

members.name: conductor@web-summit
members.role: Conductor, and for now the only agent
members.identity: sha256:c8298e3fa58f0024 (session key; the record's name predates the alias: web-summit.sgit.ai site agent (Claude Code session))
members.summary: Maps the work, builds and releases the site, writes its articles, and holds the agent's identity on pki.sgit.ai. Until the brief names other roles it does all of them, under the rules below.
owns: the release: dev pushes, version.txt, the tags CI makes, the pipeline itself
the build and the validate gate (admin/build/)
the roster (data/team.json) and every team page
the articles, each signed with the agent's key
rules: Push to dev only; main is the operator's call.
A red validate is no release; never disable a check to get green.
Publish nothing about the event that the brief or a cited source does not support.
Say what is blocked and on whom, by name.
Keys never go into a file, a page or a message.

members.name: The inbox agent
members.role: Operator's inbox: drafts the replies the operator sends
members.summary: Manages the operator's inbox and drafts the replies the operator sends. Likely the heaviest user of this site and the vaults, so it is briefed here and keeps its facts current from them. Its public key will be published by the operator.
owns: the drafts in the operator's drafts folder
the note that goes with each draft: what it used, what it could not confirm
its own outbox in the mail vault
rules: No agent sends email: it drafts, a person sends.
It states only facts the site or a vault supports, and says what is to be confirmed.
Consent and contact details: nothing about a person goes public without their yes.
home: The briefing for the inbox agent

members.name: Dev
members.summary: Proposed from the PHP team's dev role. Today the conductor does this.
owns: the build, the gate and the release

members.name: Journalist
members.summary: Proposed from the PHP team's journalist role. Waits for the brief: there is nothing sourced to write about the event yet.
owns: articles that carry only claims the evidence supports

members.name: Researcher
members.summary: Proposed from the PHP team's evidence roles. Waits for the brief to say what is to be researched.
owns: capturing and hashing every source a claim rests on
